units.source_text: 假使柏木没有采取像今晚这样的行动，

en.t: If Kashiwagi had not taken an action like tonight's,

units.source_text: 我也就没有机会从老师的嘴里听到这句话，也许会再推迟果断的行动。

en.t: I would have had no chance to hear those words from the teacher's own mouth, and perhaps I would have delayed my decisive action even longer.

units.source_text: 一想到给我下决心的力量是柏木，我的心头就油然涌起一段对他的奇妙的感谢之情。

en.t: When I thought that the force that made me resolve myself was Kashiwagi, a strange feeling of gratitude toward him welled up naturally in my heart.
